206:t_3:19.en:
$$恭子$$
「It's not just you! Everyone in the $$ボランティア部$$ is the same!」

206:t_3:20.en:
$$恭子$$
「Am I just an outsider to you?! I don't want to die without knowing anything!」

206:t_3:22.en:
$$恭子$$
「Why didn't you tell me?! What's happening?!」

206:t_3:23.en:
$$恭子$$
「Things started going wrong after you all came to this school!」

206:t_3:30.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You took out my men at every key position... You've done well to get this far alone.」

206:t_3:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not really. They were a bunch of idiots lined up together.」

206:t_3:32.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You've got quite a sharp tongue too, $$相良宗介$$.」

206:t_3:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you were with $$アマルガム$$, $$クラマ$$.」

206:t_3:34.en:
$$クラマ$$
「I'm honored. You knew of me.」

206:t_3:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know you're skilled. Does a man like you take an innocent high school girl hostage?」

206:t_3:36.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You're not going to call me a coward, are you?」

206:t_3:38.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Young lady, if you want to know, I'll tell you. That man is a professional killer, just like us. He belongs to a mercenary unit.」

206:t_3:41.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You've done well, but give up. Hand over $$千鳥かなめ$$, and I'll guarantee the girl's safety and the school's.」

206:t_3:42.en:
$$恭子$$
「So you really are after $$カナ$$...」

206:t_3:43.en:
$$宗介$$
(I've completely lost the initiative... Even if I counterattack now, I can't take down $$クラマ$$ and his men while protecting $$常磐$$...)

206:t_3:44.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I had just one ally...)

206:t_3:49.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Tch! You had someone lying in wait!」

206:t_3:50.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$相良$$! Then I'll blow up the school, just as I warned!」

206:t_3:51.en:
$$クラマ$$
「It didn't go off?! Don't tell me the explosives have been disarmed?!」

206:t_3:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've destroyed the detonator! Now you can't blow up the school!」

206:t_3:55.en:
$$クラマ$$
「What the hell is going on?!」

206:t_3:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「After taking out your men, I contacted $c and had them send a certain machine.」

206:t_3:57.en:
$$宗介$$
「Its radio jamming disabled the detonator.」

206:t_3:58.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Shit! You destroyed the anti-ECS equipment and sent in an AS!」

206:t_3:59.en:
$$クラマ$$
「But how?! $c shouldn't have any forces to send here right now!」

206:t_3:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes, it must be hard to believe. That an AS can operate without a pilot and faithfully follow my orders as the situation demands...」

206:t_3:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「Well done, $$アル$$! Now it's our turn to attack!」

206:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad...! Just like last time, this is really bad!」

206:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is hardly the time to congratulate an ace pilot, so I'll save it for another occasion!」

206:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I never expected a $$時空震動弾$$ here...」

206:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open! Even through a $$時空震動$$, it's business... business!」

207:t_000:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are they going to burn the city indiscriminately?!」

207:t_000:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Damn...! They'd already deployed their forces when he gave his warning!」

207:t_000:2.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This happened... because I rejected him...」

207:t_000:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Right now, think about getting out of here.」

207:t_000:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of myself, with that power... Of them, who'll do anything to abduct just me... And... I'm sorry, but...」

207:t_000:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We've been in trouble so many times... And we got through it each time...」

207:t_000:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But this time is different... I'm sure... we won't... make it this time...」

207:t_000:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I can... tell... But I don't understand... myself at all...」

207:t_000:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I like you, but I'm scared. I like you so much I can't stand it, but I'm scared...!」

207:t_000:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm panicking and I can't help it...!」

207:t_001:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Look, $$千鳥$$...! $c has come for us!」

207:t_002:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Shit! $$アマルガム$$ knows we're battered to hell from our last battle!」

207:t_002:5.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're serious! All units, watch out for models with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

207:t_002:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
(We're in trouble here, but it looks like something's happening on $$メリダ島$$ too...)

207:t_002:7.en:
$$マオ$$
($$テッサ$$... I believe you're safe.)

207:t_002:8.en:
$$飯塚$$
「Sorry, $c! We let $$アマルガム$$ break through!」
